summary: Descartes Systems Group (Nasdaq:DSGX) filed a Form 6-K reporting its acquisition of Idelic, a provider of AI-powered driver safety solutions. Descartes paid ~$28 million upfront in cash, with up to $12 million in potential performance-based earn-out over two years post-acquisition based on revenue targets. The deal adds critical data to Descartes' Global Logistics Network and enhances fleet safety capabilities; no board recommendation or advisor was named. The acquisition is expected to close with cash on hand, and the earn-out may be paid in fiscal 2028/2029. Watch for integration milestones and earn-out achievement as key catalysts.
